name: Erzgebirge/Krušnohoří Mining Region
description: The Ore Mountains straddle the border between Saxony in Germany and north-western Czechia, a landscape reshaped by some 800 years of nearly continuous mining. From 1460 to 1560 it was Europe's leading source of silver, and later it yielded tin and uranium. Today you can explore old mine shafts, water-channel networks, smelting sites and the mining towns that grew around them.
